verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an App API exists for 'fetching data' outside data-out integrations and a Pipelines/Track API for sending events, implying some read access, but no evidence specifically documents an endpoint or response schema for per-person message history (sent/opened/clicked) via API. missing for 10: explicit engagement/activity history endpoint documentation, example response showing per-contact sent/opened/clicked events, independent confirmation of this specific read capability.
